from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-3/play/users/u046/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=program_dir/'task-e92bccf9.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 2]
    by_row = {}
    for r, c in points:
        by_row.setdefault(r, []).append(c)
    axis_row = next(r for r, cols in by_row.items() if len(cols) == 2)
    left, right = sorted(by_row[axis_row])
    for c in range(left + 1, right):
        out[axis_row][c] = 3
    for r, c in points:
        if r == axis_row:
            continue
        step = 1 if r > axis_row else -1
        for rr in range(axis_row + step, r, step):
            out[rr][c] = 3
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, str(program_path), 'exec'))
demo_in=[[0]*13 for _ in range(19)]
for r,c in [(3,8),(6,4),(6,12),(9,10),(11,7)]: demo_in[r][c]=2
result=transform(demo_in)
expected=[[0]*13 for _ in range(19)]
for r,c in [(3,8),(6,4),(6,12),(9,10),(11,7)]: expected[r][c]=2
for c in range(5,12): expected[6][c]=3
# vertical strokes, excluding endpoints
for c,r0,r1 in [(8,3,6),(10,6,9),(7,6,11)]:
    for rr in range(r0+1,r1): expected[rr][c]=3
print('match',result==expected)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in result))
